title: Theduckguyya's Clear Glass
description: Make your glass clean and fresh.
body:

Stop trying hundreds of clear glass texture packs! Theduckguyya's Clear Glass will be the last one you'll get! Instead of the texture pack not working, being invisible or incompatable, Theduckguyya's Clear Glass fixes that
